design_condition: The building follows the street line, creating a southern rectangular outdoor area while its eastern passage connection and northern classroom alignment sit uneasily with the surrounding routes and neighbourhood street.

positive.statement: The special and ancillary rooms are functionally well organized on the lower floor.

position.rationale: Lower-floor program is approximated toward one end of the rectangular footprint.

positive.statement: The separate hall entrance connects the building well with the adjacent residential area.

position.rationale: Entrance is constrained to the eastern side passage connection.

positive.statement: The carefully developed middle zone gives the class clusters a distinctive architectural character.

position.rationale: Central longitudinal zone is legible within the rectangular roof and elevation bands.

positive.statement: The skylight provides zenithal daylight to the central zone and adjacent classrooms.

position.rationale: Distinctive central roof opening is visible in the top view and associated with upper level.

negative.statement: The centrally placed niches are too far from the classrooms to be fully operational.

position.rationale: Niches are approximated in the central interior portion of the footprint.

negative.statement: The flexibility of the middle-zone group rooms is questionable because of fire-protection constraints and the lack of escape routes.

position.target: middle-zone group rooms and escape routes
position.rationale: Fire-safety concern is anchored to the central middle-zone volume.

negative.statement: The northern classroom alignment with the neighbourhood street is problematic, and the outdoor design does not respond to it.

position.target: northern classroom alignment and outdoor design
position.rationale: Northern edge of the rectangular building is used as the street-facing alignment.

negative.statement: The construction and materialization remain too vague.

position.rationale: Building-wide construction concern is anchored to the visible envelope and floor bands.

negative.statement: The generous pre-zones are of limited use and cannot be furnished freely for fire-safety reasons.

position.rationale: Pre-zone concern is approximated along a perimeter circulation edge.
